articles.headline: Achraf Hakimi scores 1st career hat trick as Luis Enrique makes PSG history
articles.description: Right back Achraf Hakimi claimed a first career hat trick and provided two assists as Luis Enrique became the winningest coach in Paris Saint-Germain history on Friday.
articles.headlineJa: アシュラフ・ハキミがキャリア初のハットトリック、ルイス・エンリケがPSGの歴史を塗り替える
articles.descriptionJa: 金曜日、右サイドバックのアシュラフ・ハキミがキャリア初のハットトリックを達成し、2アシストを記録。ルイス・エンリケはパリ・サンジェルマン史上最多勝利を記録する監督となった。
articles.body:
Right back Achraf Hakimi claimed a first career hat trick and provided two assists as Luis Enrique became the winningest coach in Paris Saint-Germain history on Friday.

The Ligue 1 leaders came from behind to thrash bottom club Le Havre 5-1 with Morocco international Hakimi playing a role in all five goals.

- PSG's Luis Enrique: Vitinha's Ballon d'Or ranking too low

- PSG star Kvaratskhelia undergoes successful knee surgery

He is just the fourth player with five goal contributions in a single game in the last four seasons in the top five European leagues. The last player to achieve that feat in France's Ligue 1 was Neymar for PSG in August 2022.

The result took Luis Enrique to 127 wins, breaking a tie with Laurent Blanc for most in PSG's history.

The reigning French and European champions briefly looked in danger of suffering a major shock when former Sunderland and West Brom forward Josh Maja gave the winless hosts an 18th-minute lead.

But captain Hakimi set up Mika Godts to level before completing the turnaround with a smart finish two minutes later and then curling home a fine 20-yard free kick early in the second half.

Hakimi, who had not scored this season ahead of kickoff, completed his landmark treble in fortuitous fashion in the 69th minute, after his through ball allowed Senny Mayulu to register the visitors' fourth goal.

The 27-year-old's first hat trick for club and country came in the 486th game of his career.

PSG's victory was their ninth in a row in all competitions -- and sixth successive league win -- after they picked up just a point from their opening three fixtures.

In the continued absence of key attackers Ousmane Dembélé and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia through injury, Luis Enrique made five changes to his starting XI following Monday's 2-0 success over Lyon.

Information from ESPN Research and PA contributed to this report.

articles.headline: With 10 games left and Ejiro Evero out, what's next for Panthers' defense?
articles.description: Here are three reasons for optimism as Carolina makes a defensive coordinator change to Todd Wash.
articles.headlineJa: 残り10試合、エジロ・エベロの離脱を受けパンサーズの守備はどうなるのか？
articles.descriptionJa: カロライナがディフェンシブ・コーディネーターをトッド・ウォッシュに変更した中、楽観視できる3つの理由を紹介する。
articles.body:
The Carolina Panthers (3-4) are moving in a new direction on defense following Friday's firing of defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero.

On Thursday night, the Panthers lost their second consecutive game, falling 27-19 to the Green Bay Packers at Lambeau Field.

With Evero now out of the mix, Carolina will look to improve the league's 23rd-ranked defense, which ranks third worst in the NFL against the run through seven games. During the former coordinator's tenure the unit ranked 30th in scoring defense, 28th in pass rush win rate and last in rushing defense, so there's room for improvement heading into Carolina's final 10 games of the 2026 season.

The Panthers next play Nov. 8 against the visiting Denver Broncos.

Evero's departure is an opportunity to switch things up under coach Dave Canales entering the midway point of his third season at the helm. And given the outlook of the defense and the main characters in it, there are reasons to believe the group can improve in short order.

Here are three reasons for optimism as the Panthers change coordinators and switch up their defense entering that Week 9 game:

Todd Wash will be the new voice calling plays on defense

Carolina will hand the defense to interim coordinator Todd Wash for the remainder of the season. Wash was one of two assistant coaches on that side of the ball who had a coordinator background, the other being secondary coach Renaldo Hill.

Wash served as defensive coordinator for the Jacksonville Jaguars from 2016 to 2020. During the 2017 season, Wash oversaw the league's No. 2-ranked defense and helped guide the Jaguars to the AFC Championship Game under coach Doug Marrone. Wash also has a long history with Canales and general manager Dan Morgan. The trio worked together with the Seattle Seahawks from 2011 to 2012, as Wash and Canales were assistants under then-coach Pete Carroll and Morgan worked as a scout in the front office.

Wash has a background with several different schemes. His hybrid front in Jacksonville mixed and matched odd- and even-front tendencies with four- and three-man trench groups.

Given the Panthers' midseason coordinator switch, Wash might still need to lean on Evero's scheme, but he can toy with the fronts in the weeks ahead. Carolina struggled to rush the passer and stop the run during Evero's tenure, and Wash, a longtime defensive line coach, could try to make the most of his well-paid top-tier talent in the front seven by altering game plans around the base principles of Evero's system so players aren't learning on the fly.

Defensive linemen Derrick Brown, Bobby Brown III and Tershawn Wharton have scheme versatility. So, too, do outside linebackers Jaelan Phillips, Patrick Jones II and Princely Umanmielen. Inside linebackers Devin Lloyd and Bobby Okereke can adapt as well if needed.

Injured players will be making their returns

Trending rumors

articles.headline: Ja Morant out at least 4 weeks with hamstring strain suffered against Grizzlies
articles.description: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out at least four weeks.
articles.headlineJa: ジャ・モラント、グリズリーズ戦でのハムストリング損傷により少なくとも4週間の離脱
articles.descriptionJa: トレイルブレイザーズのガード、ジャ・モラントは、古巣グリズリーズとの初戦で左ハムストリングの損傷を負い、少なくとも4週間は戦列を離れる見込みだ。
articles.body:
Portland Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant has sustained a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and will be out at least four weeks before being reevaluated, the team announced Friday.

Morant suffered the injury while playing in his first game against his former team, the Memphis Grizzlies, on Thursday night. He exited in the fourth quarter and did not return.

Coach Micah Nori said postgame that Morant felt a twinge in his hamstring before leaving the game.

The setback comes amid a promising start for Morant and the Trail Blazers, who are 3-1 entering Friday. The four-week timeline means that Morant will miss at least the next 15 games. The Trail Blazers begin a four-game road trip against the Utah Jazz on Saturday.

Morant, who was acquired by Portland in a surprising offseason trade, has joined Damian Lillard in a star-studded backcourt that has delivered the NBA's No. 3 offense through Thursday. Morant, a two-time All-Star, scored a season-high 23 points in a victory over the Los Angeles Lakers on Tuesday. He has averaged 15.8 points and 5.5 assists over his first four games with the Trail Blazers.

In Morant's absence, Nori will likely lean more heavily on backup guards Jrue Holiday and Scoot Henderson. The first-year coach said earlier this week that he had sought to limit minutes for both Lillard and Morant to take advantage of his backcourt depth.

Morant, 27, has dealt with a series of injuries in recent seasons, and he played in just 20 games in 2025-26 due to an elbow sprain.

Information from The Associated Press was used in this report.

articles.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley carries no injury designation for Commanders matchup
articles.description: Saquon Barkley, who did not practice Wednesday or Thursday and was a limited participant Friday, carries no designation into Sunday's game.
articles.headlineJa: イーグルスのサクオン・バークリー、カマンドラーズ戦に向け怪我の報告なし
articles.descriptionJa: 水曜と木曜の練習を欠席し、金曜日は限定的な参加となったサクオン・バークリーだが、日曜日の試合に向けて怪我による出場制限の指定は受けていない。
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- Eagles running back Saquon Barkley appears in line to play Sunday night against the Washington Commanders.

Barkley did not practice Wednesday or Thursday and was a limited participant Friday but carries no designation into the game.

He entered Week 7 against the Dallas Cowboys with a hamstring injury and had his back lock up on him over the course of Monday's game, forcing him to miss a portion of the second half. He played nine snaps and got the ball every time he was on the field, totaling 71 yards and a touchdown.

"I would hope so, I believe I'll be able to," Barkley said when asked after Friday's practice if he thinks he'll play against Washington. "There's one day I'm not going to be playing football. Whenever that is, I don't want to look back and be like, 'I could have given it a chance and I didn't.' It's kind of what I live by. I'm going to try my best to just keep recovering, being smart, but I like playing football, so if I have an opportunity to play, I'm going to try my best to play."

With running backs Tank Bigsby, Will Shipley, Dameon Pierce and Carson Steele all on injured reserve, Jaydon Blue and Elijah Mitchell are the Eagles' other backfield options against the Commanders.

Philadelphia again will be without their top receivers in DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) as they attempt to end a five-game slide.

Linebacker Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad), cornerback Jonathan Jones (hamstring) and returner/receiver Britain Covey (knee) also have been ruled out. Nolan Smith does not have an injury designation after missing last week's game with a concussion.

articles.headline: Source: Fever hires Blazers' Sheri Sam as assistant GM
articles.description: Sheri Sam, who was the scouting manager for the Trail Blazers, has been hired as assistant general manager of the WNBA's Fever, a source told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 関係者によると、フィーバーがブレイザーズのシェリ・サムをアシスタントGMに採用
articles.descriptionJa: トレイルブレイザーズのスキャウティングマネージャーを務めていたシェリ・サムが、WNBAのフィーバーのアシスタントGMに採用されたと関係者がESPNに語った。
articles.body:
The Indiana Fever have hired Sheri Sam as assistant general manager, a source confirmed to ESPN on Friday.

Sam joins the Fever from the Portland Trail Blazers, where she had held the position of scouting manager since 2022. She played 10 years in the WNBA and won championships in Seattle (2004) and Detroit (2008).

Her responsibilities with the Trail Blazers included collegiate and professional player scouting and evaluation. The Fever had planned to invest in their scouting and analytics efforts, and the addition of Sam was one step in that direction.

Indiana remains without a team president and general manager after Kelly Krauskopf stepped down and Amber Cox was fired last week.

The Fever lost to the Las Vegas Aces in the first round of the playoffs after finishing with a 28-16 regular-season record and earning the No. 6 seed for the third consecutive season.

Sam's hiring was first reported by the Indy Star.

articles.headline: Chiefs get Rashee Rice back from injury for Broncos game
articles.description: Chiefs receiver Rashee Rice is expected back from a hamstring injury against the Broncos on Sunday.
articles.headlineJa: チーフス、ラスヒー・ライスが怪我から復帰しブロンコス戦へ
articles.descriptionJa: チーフスのレシーバー、ラスヒー・ライスは、日曜日のブロンコス戦でハムストリングの怪我から復帰する見込みだ。
articles.body:
KANSAS CITY, Mo. -- Rashee Rice, the Kansas City Chiefs' top receiver, is expected to return to the lineup for Sunday's game against the Denver Broncos.

Rice participated in each of the Chiefs' three practices this week and is returning from a strained right hamstring, an injury he suffered in Week 4 against the Las Vegas Raiders.

Without Rice the past two games, the Chiefs' offense hasn't been as effective as it was earlier in the season. Quarterback Patrick Mahomes didn't throw a touchdown pass in either game, and the Chiefs' collection of receivers -- Xavier Worthy, rookie Cyrus Allen, Justin Watson, Andrew Armstrong and Jalen Royals -- recorded just six receptions for 39 yards in last week's loss to the Seahawks.

In four games this season, Rice has produced 13 receptions on 16 targets for 190 yards and a touchdown.

"He's such a physical receiver," Mahomes said Wednesday of Rice. "He does a great job within the zone concepts at getting himself open, as well as being physical versus man [coverage]. Having him back out there will be big for us because it'll help take some pressure off the other guys to make plays and let them go out there and be themselves. Hopefully, we can have some success."

On defense, the Chiefs could be without rookie cornerback Mansoor Delane, their top draft pick, who is listed as questionable.

Delane missed practice Thursday and Friday with a right shoulder injury, the same injury he aggravated three snaps into the season-opening win over the Broncos following an interception before missing Week 2.

After Friday's practice, Reid said he didn't know what Delane's status was for Sunday's rematch. Delane first sustained his injury in the offseason, as he missed the Chiefs' mandatory minicamp in June because of a hairline fracture in his scapula, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

"We'll just see how he does here going forward," Reid said of Delane.

Rookie defensive end R Mason Thomas also missed Friday's practice for a personal reason. Reid, though, said the Chiefs expect Thomas to play against the Broncos.

"He'll meet us there in Denver," Reid said of Thomas.

articles.headline: Bills making contingencies if hurt starters aren't available
articles.description: The Bills have listed starters DJ Moore (shoulder), right tackle Spencer Brown (back) and nickel Dee Alford (ankle) as questionable vs. the Ravens.
articles.headlineJa: ビルズ、負傷したスターターが出場できない場合に備え代替策を検討
articles.descriptionJa: ビルズは、スターターのDJムーア（肩）、ライトタックルのスペンサー・ブラウン（背中）、ニッケルのディー・アルフォード（足首）のレイブンズ戦への出場を不透明としている。
articles.body:
ORCHARD PARK, N.Y. -- As has become his custom, Buffalo Bills coach Joe Brady isn't ruling anyone out for Sunday's game despite multiple players missing most or all of this week's practices.

That said, preparation for this particular matchup against the Baltimore Ravens at Highmark Stadium comes with a few extra contingencies.

Brady ruled several players as questionable, including starters such as receiver DJ Moore (shoulder), right tackle Spencer Brown (back) and nickel Dee Alford (ankle).

Brown did not practice this week, while Alford missed practice Thursday and Friday. Moore was present for all three practices but donned a noncontact jersey.

Alford's potential absence creates the most complications as the Bills will be without safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson, who must serve a one-game suspension stemming from his spitting incident in Week 6 against the Las Vegas Raiders. When Alford was injured earlier in the season, the Bills turned to safety Damar Hamlin to fill his spot. With Hamlin starting for Gardner-Johnson on Sunday, the plan at nickel is more variable.

"There's a lot of possibilities that we've played this year with," Brady said Friday. "We have a lot of thoughts. But these are things you don't have to think about when Dee's out there."

Ravens star receiver Zay Flowers lines up in the slot for more than half of his snaps. The Bills were not shy about giving No. 1 cornerback Christian Benford some slot reps in their most recent game as he shadowed tight end Brock Bowers, and Brady said other outside cornerbacks including Maxwell Hairston are capable of bumping inside as needed.

As for Brown, he jokes he took enough medication to "sedate a small elephant" in order to take the field against the Raiders. He said that during the ensuing bye week, however, the lingering back issues and the aftereffects of playing in Week 6 "bit [him] in the butt a little bit."

Brown said this week that "I can be ready whenever."

Moore has not played since Week 4, but he indicated earlier in the week that the time away did him some good and helped put him "in the best spot for the team."

The Bills also listed tight end Dalton Kincaid and defensive lineman Greg Gaines as questionable. Kincaid has practiced this week in a noncontact jersey, while Gaines sustained an injury during Friday's practice.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich not allowing Kompany to be involved in Dortmund clash
articles.description: Vincent Kompany won't be on the sidelines for Bayern's match against Borussia Dortmund following his hospitalization last week.
articles.body:
MUNICH -- Bayern Munich are not allowing coach Vincent Kompany to be part of their plans for Saturday's Klassiker against Bundesliga rival Borussia Dortmund following his collapse and hospitalization last week.

Assistant coach Aaron Danks said on Friday there were orders not to discuss the game with Kompany, even though he's out of hospital and recovering at home.

"We don't talk to him about football. We've been given clear instructions there," Danks said. "He needs to recover and spend time with his family. We're not getting him involved so he can be fully back at it when he returns."

Danks oversaw a 6-1 win over Magdeburg in the German Cup on Wednesday. Saturday's game against Dortmund is likely to see Harry Kane return to action after winning the Ballon d'Or on Monday.

Danks said not much has changed in how Bayern are training for the game, adding that Kompany's assistants aren't "mini-Vinnies" but have skill sets which complement each other to work together in his absence.

Bayern board member for sport Max Eberl told German broadcaster ARD on Wednesday that Kompany was treated for meningeal irritation, which is an inflammation of the tissue around the brain or spinal cord.

Before his collapse, Kompany had also been struggling with a viral infection and a hip injury.

Knicks plan to decline Dadiet's fourth-year option

The New York Knicks are planning to decline Pacome Dadiet's fourth-year option worth $5.37 million, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania. The decision will make Dadiet an unrestricted free agent next summer.

Oct. 28

How Dybantsa will impact the Wizards on the court

After missing the first four games of the season with an ankle injury, No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa will make his regular-season debut Wednesday, ESPN's Shams Charania reported.

Dybantsa's arrival could give the Wizards one of the best starting lineups in the Eastern Conference -- which would be quite a change of pace for a team that hasn't won 20 games in a season since 2022-23. Anthony Davis has been explosive and productive through four games. Trae Young is averaging 22 points and a league-best 11 assists per game. And Kyshawn George is up to 18 PPG as he continues to make strides as an all-around NBA contributor. Add Dybantsa to that mix and there's legitimate reason for excitement in Washington.

The only downside is that Dybantsa should command plenty of playing time, which could further squeeze an overcrowded Wizards rotation. Already, 2025 first-rounder Will Riley has seen his playing time crater, but he, Tre Johnson and Bilal Coulibaly are all wings who will now likely come off the bench, yet deserve the opportunity to continue their development. -- Zach Kram

articles.headline: USMNT star Christian Pulisic signs new AC Milan contract through 2031
articles.description: United States star Christian Pulisic has signed a new contract with AC Milan through 2031.
articles.body:
United States star Christian Pulisic has signed a new contract with AC Milan through 2031.

The deal for Pulisic, 28, was reported by ESPN on Wednesday and confirmed on Friday, a day after AC Milan announced plans for their new stadium.

"Captain America's Rossonero mission continues," wrote AC Milan on Friday.

Pulisic's deal was due to expire in June 2027, but he has committed his future to the Rossoneri on a contract that will take him beyond the next World Cup.

"There's a lot of emotions, I'm really proud to re-sign here in Milan because I'm really just in love with this team, this club, everything about it," Pulisic said in an interview on the club's social media pages. "The feeling that I got, the support from the fans through all of the good and bad times, I knew immediately that this was the place for me.:

He joined AC Milan in 2023 from Chelsea for a fee in the region of €22 million ($24.4m). At the Serie A club, Pulisic has 44 goals and 28 assists across his 141 appearances and was the club's top scorer in the 2024-25 season.

"Milan has given me everything, it feels like home for me," he said. "It's where I want to spend my next years because I'm just really happy here, I love it here, my family loves it here. I want to continue to give everything and bring this club to the top.

He added: "I look at my whole life as a book, to be honest, and i feel like this is the most important chapter right now."

Pulisic signed for Borussia Dortmund back in 2015 and established himself as one of the best young players in the Bundesliga. Chelsea signed him for £58m ($71.7m) in 2018, and he won the 2021 Champions League there.

But injury disrupted his progress at Chelsea, and in 2023, AC Milan saw off competition from Juventus, Lyon and Galatasaray to sign him.

- Pulisic staying in Milan reflects his club career: Good, but not quite great

- Cavan Sullivan turned 17 last month, but he's already playing like an MLS MVP

- Ex-USMNT star Eddie Johnson to train 3-year-old removed from Florida soccer game

Pulisic missed most of AC Milan's preseason due to the injury he sustained during the World Cup. But after a steady reintegration into the first team under Ruben Amorim, he has become an integral part of the manager's Milan blueprint, playing in the No. 10 role and on the wing.

Pulisic's new deal follows the unveiling of AC Milan's new stadium, which will be ready in 2031. The clubs said in a news release Thursday that the deal represented "one of the largest stadium naming rights agreements in global sport."

At the international level, Pulisic has established himself as a key player for the USMNT with 33 goals in 90 appearances. He played in the 2022 and 2026 World Cups for the USMNT and won U.S. Soccer Male Player of the Year in 2017, 2019, 2021 and 2023.

articles.description: Marco Rose will hold Bournemouth forward Junior Kroupi back for a little longer despite more minutes in midweek.
